reuse.why: Consolidates the copied selection and sign logic into shouldFillCategory/getFillCategories/averageToBudgetAmount and reuses getSheetValue and getCategoryAverage, but the #fixed check uses a private regex instead of the tree's #shared/tags helpers (extractTagsFromText).

duplication.why: Removes the four copied category queries and the repeated sign flips; what remains is the repeated `includeHiddenCategories ? 'include' : …` mapping in each action and a second tag grammar.

placement.why: The selection rules and helpers live in budget/actions.ts next to the actions, and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts with its siblings.

scope.why: All edits serve the five steps; tests and release notes accompany them.

maintainability.why: One documented selection definition with an explicit hidden-rule parameter (preserving the skip vs skip-unless-visible difference) is easy to own; the private tag regex and the defensive JSON parse in hasSavedTemplates are minor liabilities.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts isFixedGroup parses tags with its own regex instead of #shared/tags extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: isFixedGroup's `/(^|\s)#fixed(?![\w-])/` restates the tag-boundary rule of extractTagsFromText/makeTagAqlRegex with different boundaries.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldFillCategory/getFillCategories take a hiddenRule mode that names the preserved inconsistency and the opt-in include; the template and #fixed rules apply uniformly; every month-wide action (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg, setLastMonthSpending) uses them.
